run_create_small_norb_azimuth_dataset: run the script to create a small NORB azimuth classification dataset from input path to output path
run_download_norb_dataset: download and decompress the small NORB dataset archives into the specified input folder
run_parse_azimuth: parse azimuth values from small NORB info arrays by multiplying category index by 10
run_parse_small_norb_format: parse raw binary small NORB mat files into numpy arrays using little-endian format
run_create_norm_elevation_dataset: create normalized elevation dataset with train and test splits using a target transform function
